text:
megan: Quick heads-up: engineering plan to deprecate legacy auth header `X-RW-Auth-Legacy` across public SDKs. Target removal date: 2025-06-20. Need partner coordination plan and short-term escape hatch.
raj: Can we provide a per-account allowlist and a per-request transient header that partners can set while they migrate? Suggest `X-RW-Legacy-Override` with a TTL and audit telemetry.
olivia: PartnerY's SI templates still inject the legacy header in proxy layer. They need a non-SDK escape. A runtime header that proxy can add w/o SDK churn is ideal.
sam: Ops note: server will accept legacy header only for accounts on allowlist. We'll add metrics `legacy_auth.allowlist.accepted` and `legacy_auth.rejected`. Also implement a short-lived KV lookup for legacy session mapping during migrations (30 days).
legal-bot: Reminder: update partner addendum and send 60-day notice where contractually required. I can produce template language; need the official timeline and fallback terms.
megan: Proposed rollout: PRs open by 2025-04-05, SDK patch releases 2025-04-20, internal canary 2025-05-05, invite-only partner canary 2025-05-20, public announcement 2025-06-01, hard removal 2025-06-20. Thoughts?
raj: Slight tweak: allow partners in the partner canary to request 14-day extended grace per account via the partner portal so we don't block revenue ops. We should log any extensions.
olivia: PartnerY asked for a test checklist today. I'll draft scenarios: legacy-only, new-token-only, both headers present (new token precedence), rotation while session active, header mangling by proxies.
sam: Server behavior pseudocode: 
```
if (account.allowlist.includes(req.account)) {
  if (req.headers['X-RW-New-Auth']) useNew();
  else if (req.headers['X-RW-Legacy'] || req.headers['X-RW-Legacy-Override']) useLegacy();
} else {
  if (req.headers['X-RW-New-Auth']) useNew();
  else reject(401);
}
emitMetric('legacy_auth.used', true/false);
```
megan: Ops: add an endpoint in partner portal to request allowlist and to view allowlist status. Partnerships should approve/deny requests and record justification. Partners must include migration ETA.
legal-bot: Also flag: partners that require >30 day allowlist need an SLA amendment. I'll route to contracts.
raj: SDKs will warn prominently in logs when legacy header present and include a migration link. Provide an opt-in runtime flag `legacyAuth.allow = true` for advanced customers; default false.
olivia: PartnerY wants a canned customer-facing note and a joint marketplace banner draft. Dana from marketing isn't in this thread; can partnerships loop them in?
megan: I'll add marketing and product to a follow-up thread. For now, partnerships own the partner comms draft. Please make it one page: what, impact, steps, contact.
sam: Canary-bot queued partner canary on 2025-05-20 09:00 UTC — id canary-1982. We'll monitor `legacy_auth.*` metrics and error spikes.
raj: For emergency rollbacks, we'll support a short-term server-side flag to re-enable legacy for all accounts for up to 48 hours while we triage. That will be gated by SRE approval and will create an incident log.
olivia: I'll send PartnerY the test matrix and ask them to schedule a joint run. They asked for our draft by EOD.
megan: Action items: 1) engineering: allowlist + header accept logic + metrics (raj + sam) 2) partner comms + customer note (olivia + partnerships) 3) legal: addendum + notice template (legal-bot) 4) partner portal allowlist UX (product). Please post ETAs here.
raj: ETA: initial PR 2025-04-05, code review week, SDK patches 2025-04-18.
olivia: ETA: comms draft by 2025-04-03 EOD, test matrix shared today.
legal-bot: ETA: addendum draft 2025-04-07.
megan: Great. Let's reconvene next Tue 10am PT to review comms and allowlist flow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
